conventions_frozen_and_unchanged.window: w = min(m, tau), random denominator, alarm-causing increment included
conventions_frozen_and_unchanged.detector_boundary: alarm tested after the update, boundary inclusive (>=)
conventions_frozen_and_unchanged.uncertainty_convention: batch standard error: one mean per batch, SE = spread of batch means

unresolved_gates.gate: P4X obligation C2 / Checkpoint A gate X6
unresolved_gates.statement: theorem-supported correspondence: relative discrepancy <= 0.03 AND |z| <= 4 on all 96 cells, after each route reaches r* or is declared PRECISION_LIMITED
same gate, at P4's own precision
unresolved_gates.historical_status: false; superseded in substance by P4X C2 but never itself repaired, and P4Z does not repair it

per_estimand_requirements.quantity: Gamma_{D,m,f}, a positive real of order 1 to 20 across the grid
per_estimand_requirements.sign_or_threshold_target: none on Gamma itself; the gate is a two-route agreement, not a sign test

required_relative_accuracy.status: FROZEN, inherited from the Track-3 location-family gate, not altered by P4Z

required_per_route_relative_se.derivation: 1.96 * sqrt(2) * r* = 0.03; forced by the unchanged 3 % criterion, not chosen
required_per_route_relative_se.status: FROZEN, inherited from P4X Checkpoint A section 8

p4z_design_target_relative_se.status: a P4Z design choice, tighter than r* by 4.33x; tightening a precision target is not a threshold change

per_estimand_requirements.certificate_semantics: frequentist two-sample agreement between two independently constructed routes; NOT a deterministic enclosure of Gamma
per_estimand_requirements.unbiasedness_rationale: the gate compares two route means directly; a biased route would shift the discrepancy without shifting either standard error, and no part of the frozen gate can absorb that
per_estimand_requirements.deterministic_enclosure_note: interval certification in this line covers exactly three analytic objects and no frozen operating point; P4Z does not extend that boundary
per_estimand_requirements.common_random_numbers_note: already the frozen Route-B convention; the Philox stream keyed on (seed, batch, step) with a 2^64 stride is inherited unchanged
per_estimand_requirements.control_variates_note: admissible in principle, but the obvious one is dead: P4X R0 measured the Corollary-G2 control variate as exactly degenerate, per-path variance 6e-29 to 9e-31, which is G2's own content
per_estimand_requirements.importance_sampling_note: admissible only with an exactly known likelihood ratio, since any weight error is a bias and unbiasedness is required. Not used by either P4Z candidate.
per_estimand_requirements.antithetic_note: admissible but measured useless: P4X R0 found reflection-antithetic pathwise exact and distributionally valid, with a variance reduction factor of 0.001-0.003, i.e. a 300-1000x variance INCREASE, because substituting the mirror destroys the CRN cancellation
per_estimand_requirements.conditioning_constraint: only on sigma-algebras generated by the frozen path up to a stopping-time-measurable index; conditioning on any future information, on the realised alarm time viewed from the end, or on the outcome of the gate is inadmissible

prior_art_exclusions_inherited_from_p4x_.measured_outcome: inadmissibly biased for skewnormal4 (+4.94 and +33.01 baseline SEs)
